claim: Long tasks represent browser main-thread tasks above the long-task threshold; they are not automatically Slate-owned.
Attribution is a list of TaskAttributionTiming entries, so the harness should report when task duration is unattributed or only partially attributed.
The browser may provide container/window/source-style attribution fields, but this is claim-width evidence, not a runtime blame oracle.
The API observes tasks that block important work on the UI thread; it should be used to flag latency risk and then cross-check app profiler/timer data.

ProseMirror writes model selection to DOM only when the editor owns selection and has drag-selection browser guards.

ProseMirror explicitly guards against updates arriving between DOM selection change and the selectionchange event disrupting mouse drag selection.
